creativeDirection: Steady, self-possessed adult confidence, direct warm attention, playful social engagement and an openly flirtatious presence.
design: Adult Vex with long rich-purple waves, violet eyes, purple wolf ears with pale inner fur and a full purple tail. Deep-magenta satin wrap blouse with a tied waist, fitted black high-waisted leather trousers, narrow silver belt, dark-plum heeled ankle boots, silver earrings and a geometric pendant. Balanced three-quarter standing pose, one hand on her hip and the other open near her waist, with direct eye contact and a knowing smile.

neutral.reference: original Gooner design in catalog v0.30.0
neutral.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE revised full-body visual-novel character sprite sample of Vex's confident, openly flirtatious persona, for the creator's design review before generating an expression set.
Edit target: the supplied existing Vex sprite. Preserve the same adult woman in her late twenties: mature facial identity and natural adult proportions, pale skin, violet eyes, long rich-purple waves, purple wolf ears with pale inner fur, and one full fluffy purple wolf tail. Preserve her polished detailed anime painting style.

Primary request: replace the formal professional styling with confident, playful adult fashion and a more engaged presence. Her appeal is steady, deliberate attention and self-possessed warmth. She comfortably meets the viewer's gaze and knows exactly what her smile communicates.

New outfit: a rich deep-magenta satin wrap blouse, fully opaque, with a neat modest V neckline and a soft tied detail at the waist; sleeves casually rolled to the forearms, natural satin sheen and folds. Fitted black high-waisted soft-leather trousers, a narrow silver belt, polished dark-plum heeled ankle boots, small silver drop earrings, and a restrained geometric silver pendant at the neckline. Clothing fits naturally. Remove the long blazer, lapel pin, black high-neck blouse and wide-leg business trousers. No outer coat.
Hair: keep the same rich purple color and long loose waves, swept mostly over one shoulder with both eyes readable. Understated hair styling without elaborate ornaments.

Pose: full-body balanced standing three-quarter view, one hand resting confidently at her hip, the other forearm turned gently outward with a small relaxed open-palm gesture near her waist, natural loosely curved fingers. A subtle forward turn of her torso toward the viewer, shoulders open and relaxed, chin level. Warm, inviting and deliberate body language. Keep the pose versatile for later expressions.
Face: sustained direct violet eye contact, relaxed attentive eyebrows, a knowing asymmetric smile with lips lightly parted as if about to say something teasing. Lifted cheeks and a clear playful spark; confident adult warmth and ease. Make her more socially engaged than the reference. Her expression should be expressive and personal, without a coy inward pose, extreme grin or cartoon eyes. Ears attentive, tail softly curved.

Portrait 1024 x 1536. ONE complete full-body character, entire ear tips, hair, hands, tail, clothing and both boot soles inside frame with comfortable clear margins. Level camera, coherent anatomy, consistent soft character lighting.
Preserve true transparent alpha, isolated character. No background, scenery, floor, cast shadow, haze, halo, glow or vignette. No text, labels, logos, extra characters, alternate views or expression sheets. No new props. Keep this a naturally posed, fully clothed adult fashion portrait.
